blocks.text: Predlog savol oxirida: Who is she talking to?

O'zbek tilida qo'shimcha yoki ko'makchi savol so'zining o'ziga qo'shiladi: «**Kim bilan** gaplashyapti?», «**Nima haqida** o'ylayapsiz?», «**Kimga** qarayapsiz?», «**Qayerdan**siz?» Ingliz tilida esa predlog odatda **savolning oxirida**, fe'ldan keyin qoladi: **Who** is she talking **to**? **What** are you thinking **about**? **Where** are you **from**? Savol so'zi boshda, predlog esa oxirda — ular gapning ikki chetida turadi.

Nega shunday? Predlog fe'lga bog'langan: talk **to**, think **about**, wait **for**, look **at**. Darak gapda ular yonma-yon turadi: She is talking **to Tom**. Savolda faqat Tom ning o'rniga **who** qo'yilib, gap boshiga chiqadi, predlog esa fe'l yonida qoladi: **Who** is she talking **to**? So'z tartibining qolgan qismi 44-darsdagidek: yordamchi fe'l egadan oldin.
Fe'l + predlog: listen to, wait for, look at

Ko'p fe'llar ma'lum predlog bilan birga ishlatiladi va savolda bu predlog tushib qolmaydi. Ayniqsa o'zbekcha tushum kelishigi («kimni kutyapsiz?», «nimani qidiryapsiz?») ga inglizchada predlogli fe'l to'g'ri kelganda xato ko'p bo'ladi: wait **for** («kutmoq»), look **for** («qidirmoq»), listen **to** («tinglamoq»). Fe'l + predlog birikmalari batafsil — → 113-dars.

items.text: Who are you waiting **for**? — My brother. He's parking the car.
Which radio station do you usually listen **to**?

blocks.text: Rasmiy uslubda predlog savol boshiga chiqishi mumkin, lekin unda **whom** ishlatiladi: **With whom** did you travel? **To whom** should I send the form? Bu juda rasmiy va kundalik nutqda deyarli eshitilmaydi. «With who ...?» deb aytilmaydi — yoki rasmiy **With whom ...?**, yoki oddiy **Who ... with?**

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «Who are you waiting?» → **Who are you waiting for?**; «What are you looking?» → **What are you looking at / for?**; «With who are you talking?» → **Who are you talking to?**; «Where are you?» — «Qayerdasiz?» degani; «Qayerdansiz?» — **Where are you from?**

**What ... like?** savoli biror narsa yoki odamni tasvirlab berishni so'raydi: «... qanaqa?», «... qanday?» Bu yerda **like** — fe'l emas, «... kabi, ... ga o'xshash» ma'nosidagi predlog. Shuning uchun do / does kerak emas, fe'l — **be**: What **is** your new flat **like**? — It's small but cosy. Javobda odatda sifatlar keladi. Zamon be orqali o'zgaradi: What **was** the weather **like**? What **will** the exam **be like**?

items.text: What's Tashkent **like** in summer? — Very hot and sunny.
items.translation: Yozda Toshkent **qanday** bo'ladi? — Juda issiq va quyoshli.

items.text: What was the hotel **like**? — Clean, but a bit noisy.
items.translation: Mehmonxona **qanaqa** edi? — Toza, lekin biroz shovqinli.

items.text: What does your brother **look like**? — He's short and has a beard.
items.translation: Akangiz **qanaqa ko'rinishda**? — Past bo'yli, soqoli bor.

blocks.text: Tipik xatolar: «How is your new flat like?» → **What is your new flat like?** (yoki **How is your new flat?**); «What is like your flat?» → **What is your flat like?** (like doim oxirida); «What does she like?» ni «U qanaqa odam?» ma'nosida ishlatish — bu «nimani yoqtiradi?» degani.

Eslab qolish: savolni darak gapdan yasang. She is talking **to Tom** → Tom o'rniga **who**, uni boshga chiqaring, predlogni joyida qoldiring: **Who** is she talking **to**? Predlog — fe'lning «sherigi», savolda ham undan ajralmaydi.

Bog'liq darslar: savolda so'z tartibi — → 44-dars; who / what ega va to'ldiruvchi sifatida — → 45-dars; aniqlovchi ergash gapda ham predlog oxirida qoladi (the hotel we stayed **at**) — → 102-dars; fe'l + predlog — → 113-dars.

items: Predlog savol oxirida qoladi: **Who** are you talking **to**? **What** is it **about**? **Where** are you **from**?
Tartib: savol so'zi + yordamchi fe'l + ega + fe'l + **predlog**.
Predlogli fe'llar (wait **for**, look **for**, listen **to**) savolda ham predlogsiz qolmaydi.
**What is ... like?** — «qanaqa?» (tasvir); What does ... like? — «nimani yoqtiradi?»; What does ... look like? — «tashqi ko'rinishi»; How is ...? — «ahvoli».

examples.title: **Who** ... **to**? **Who** ... **with**? **Who** ... **for**?
examples.description: Odam haqida predlogli savollar: who boshda, predlog oxirida. O'zbekchada: «kim bilan?», «kimga?», «kimdan?», «kim uchun?»

sentences.text: Who is Madina talking **to**? — Her new boss.
sentences.translation: Madina **kim bilan** gaplashyapti? — Yangi rahbari bilan.

sentences.text: Who did you go to the cinema **with**?
That's a lovely present. Who is it **for**?
You look upset. Who are you angry **with**?
Who does this umbrella belong **to**? — I think it's Tom's.
When you were a child, who did you play **with**?
Bekzod is going to Bukhara next week. Who is he travelling **with**?
sentences.translation: Bekzod kelasi hafta Buxoroga ketyapti. U **kim bilan** boryapti?

sentences.text: Here's the letter. Who should I send it **to**?
Sorry, who were you waiting **for**? — Mr Brown. He's late.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, siz **kimni** kutayotgan edingiz? — Janob Braunni. U kechikyapti.

sentences.text: Emma got a long letter today. Who was it **from**?
sentences.translation: Emma bugun uzun xat oldi. Xat **kimdan** ekan?

examples.title: **What** ... **about**? **What** ... **for**? **What** ... **at**?
examples.description: Narsa haqida predlogli savollar: «nima haqida?», «nima uchun?», «nimaga?», «nimadan?» — inglizchada what boshda, predlog oxirida.

sentences.text: What are you thinking **about**? You look miles away.
What's this book **about**? — A family in Samarkand.
sentences.translation: Bu kitob **nima haqida**? — Samarqanddagi bir oila haqida.

sentences.text: What are you looking **at**? — That beautiful old building.
On this machine, what is the red button **for**?
Excuse me, what are you laughing **at**?
You're always nervous. What are you so worried **about**?
I need some money. — What do you need it **for**?
sentences.translation: Menga biroz pul kerak. — U sizga **nima uchun** kerak?

sentences.text: Madina is very good at drawing. What else is she interested **in**?
sentences.translation: Madina rasmni juda yaxshi chizadi. U yana **nimaga** qiziqadi?

sentences.text: In your last meeting, what did you talk **about**?
This soup is delicious. What is it made **from**?
sentences.translation: Bu sho'rva juda mazali. U **nimadan** tayyorlangan?

examples.title: **Where** ... **from**? **Which** ... **in**?
examples.description: Joy haqida predlogli savollar: **Where** are you **from**? **Which** hotel are you staying **at**? **Which** floor does she live **on**? Predlog yana oxirida.

sentences.text: Where are you **from**? — I'm from Namangan.
Where did you get that jacket **from**? It's really nice.
Which hotel are you staying **at**?
Which floor does Dilnoza live **on**?
So, which company does your husband work **for**?
The train to Oxford — which platform does it leave **from**?
Your accent is interesting. Which part of England are you **from**?
What country did Bekzod move **to** after university?
sentences.translation: Universitetdan keyin Bekzod **qaysi** davlatga ko'chib ketdi?

sentences.text: I found these keys on the floor. Which room do they belong **to**?
sentences.translation: Bu kalitlarni polda topdim. Ular **qaysi** xonaniki?

sentences.text: Which university did Emma apply **to**? — Oxford and Manchester.
sentences.translation: Emma **qaysi** universitetga hujjat topshirdi? — Oksford va Manchesterga.

examples.title: **wait for**, **look for**, **listen to**: verb + preposition
examples.description: Predlogli fe'llar savolda predlogsiz qolmaydi: wait **for** («kutmoq»), look **for** («qidirmoq»), listen **to**, depend **on**, ask **for**. O'zbekchada ko'pincha tushum kelishigi: «kimni kutyapsiz?»

sentences.text: Who are you waiting **for**? — My sister. She's always late.
What are you looking **for**? — My glasses. Have you seen them?
What kind of music do you listen **to**?
What did you pay all that money **for**?
Grandma looks tired. Who has she been looking **after** all day?
sentences.translation: Buvim charchagan ko'rinadi. U kun bo'yi **kimga** qarab o'tirdi?

sentences.text: It depends. — What does it depend **on**?
At the restaurant, what did you ask **for**? — Just some water.
Which job is Madina applying **for**?
Who are you writing **to**? — My pen friend in Manchester.
Dilnoza and Sarah are giggling. What are they laughing **about**?
sentences.translation: Dilnoza bilan Sara pixillab kulyapti. Ular **nima haqida** kulishyapti?

examples.title: Prepositions at the end in other tenses
examples.description: Predlog har qanday zamonda oxirida qoladi: Who **did** you have lunch **with**? What **was** the film **about**? Who **have** you been talking **to**? Majhul nisbatda — **by**: Who was it painted **by**?

sentences.text: Who did you have lunch **with** today?
What was the film **about**? — A young footballer from Brazil.
sentences.translation: Film **nima haqida** edi? — Braziliyalik yosh futbolchi haqida.

sentences.text: Who have you been talking **to** for two hours?
In Samarkand, which hotel will you stay **at**?
Who was this picture painted **by**?
When you lived in Oxford, which street did you live **on**?
What were you two arguing **about** last night?
Tom has a new girlfriend. — Really? Who's he going out **with**?
sentences.translation: Tomning yangi qiz do'sti bor. — Rostdanmi? U **kim bilan** uchrashyapti?

sentences.text: Bekzod will speak at the conference. What is he going to talk **about**?
sentences.translation: Bekzod konferensiyada so'zga chiqadi. U **nima haqida** gapirmoqchi?

sentences.text: What did you cut the bread **with**? There's no knife here!
sentences.translation: Nonni **nima bilan** kesdingiz? Bu yerda pichoq yo'q-ku!

examples.title: **What is it like?** — asking for a description
examples.description: **What + be + ega + like?** — «... qanaqa? / qanday?» like bu yerda predlog («... kabi»), shuning uchun do kerak emas. Zamon be orqali: What **was** it like? What **will** it **be** like?

sentences.text: What's your new flat **like**? — It's small but very cosy.
sentences.translation: Yangi kvartirangiz **qanaqa**? — Kichkina, lekin juda shinam.

sentences.text: What was the weather **like** in Samarkand? — Sunny and warm.
sentences.translation: Samarqandda havo **qanday** edi? — Quyoshli va iliq.

sentences.text: You've met Emma's new boyfriend. What's he **like**?
sentences.translation: Emmaning yangi yigiti bilan tanishdingiz. U **qanaqa** odam?

sentences.text: I'm going to Manchester next month. What's it **like** there in autumn?
sentences.translation: Kelasi oy Manchesterga boraman. Kuzda u yerda **qanday** bo'ladi?

sentences.text: What are your new neighbours **like**? — They're quiet and friendly.
sentences.translation: Yangi qo'shnilaringiz **qanaqa**? — Tinch va samimiy odamlar.

sentences.text: How was the exam? What were the questions **like**?
Bekzod has started a new job. — Oh, what's his boss **like**?
sentences.translation: Bekzod yangi ishga kirdi. — Shunaqami, rahbari **qanaqa** odam?

sentences.text: Have you been to that new café? What's the food **like**?
Sarah, what was life **like** in the village when you were young?
Tomorrow we're going hiking. What will the weather be **like**?
sentences.translation: Ertaga tog'ga sayrga chiqamiz. Havo **qanday** bo'ladi?

examples.title: **What's she like?** / **What does she like?** / **How is she?**
examples.description: Farqi: What **is** she **like**? — qanaqa odam; What **does** she **like**? — nimani yoqtiradi; What **does** she **look like**? — tashqi ko'rinishi; **How is** she? — ahvoli qanday.

sentences.text: What's your sister **like**? — She's clever and very funny.
sentences.translation: Opangiz **qanaqa** odam? — Aqlli va juda quvnoq.

sentences.text: What does your sister **like**? — Books, music and long walks.
sentences.translation: Opangiz **nimani yoqtiradi**? — Kitob, musiqa va uzoq sayr.

sentences.text: What does Aziz **look like**? — He's tall, with dark hair and glasses.
sentences.translation: Aziz **qanaqa ko'rinishda**? — Baland bo'yli, sochi qora, ko'zoynak taqadi.

sentences.text: **How's** your grandmother? — Much better, thanks. She's out of hospital.
sentences.translation: Buvingizning **ahvoli qanday**? — Ancha yaxshi, rahmat. Shifoxonadan chiqdi.

sentences.text: I've never met Dilnoza. What's she **like**? — Very kind and friendly.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza bilan hech tanishmaganman. U **qanaqa** odam? — Juda mehribon va samimiy.

sentences.text: Tom's cousin is coming to stay. What does he **like** doing in his free time?
sentences.translation: Tomning amakivachchasi mehmonga kelyapti. U bo'sh vaqtida **nima qilishni yoqtiradi**?

sentences.text: Can you describe the thief? What did he **look like**?
sentences.translation: O'g'rini tasvirlab bera olasizmi? U **qanaqa ko'rinishda** edi?

sentences.text: **How are** your parents? Are they well?
Your new teacher — what's she **like**? Is she strict?
Madina **looks like** her mother, but she's **like** her father in character.
sentences.translation: Madina tashqi ko'rinishdan onasiga **o'xshaydi**, fe'l-atvori esa otasiga **o'xshaydi**.

examples.title: Dialogue: Aziz's new job in London
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: ikki do'st suhbati. **What's ... like?** va oxirida predlogli savollar (**Who ... with? What ... at? Which part ... in?**).

sentences.text: — So, Aziz, what's your new job **like**?
— It's really interesting. I **work for** a big travel company.
— Who do you work **with**? Are your colleagues friendly?
— Mostly **with** people from Spain and Italy. They're lovely.
sentences.translation: — Asosan Ispaniya va Italiyadan kelganlar **bilan**. Ular juda yoqimli.

sentences.text: — And what's your boss **like**?
— She's strict but fair. What are you laughing **at**?
— Nothing, I'm just happy for you! Which part of London is your office **in**?
sentences.translation: — Hech narsaga, shunchaki sen uchun xursandman! Ofising Londonning **qaysi** qismida?

sentences.text: — In the centre. I can see the river **from** my window!
— Lucky you! Who do you usually have lunch **with**?
sentences.translation: — Omading bor ekan! Odatda **kim bilan** tushlik qilasan?

sentences.text: — With a girl from Manchester. Her name's Sarah... What are you smiling **at** now?
sentences.translation: — Manchesterlik bir qiz bilan. Ismi Sara... Endi **nimaga** jilmayyapsan?
